claims.summary: The release does not claim 100/100; it targets one deterministic ordering issue from the latest v0.15.71 95/A ZIP/log audit.
The in-pipeline voice pass is skipped when enrichment coverage is partial, keeping repair ahead of optional texture polish.
The generation pipeline records a voice-pass skip decision with the exact enrichment coverage gap.
Focused voice-pass and enrichment regressions pin that full enrichment remains eligible for voice polish while partial enrichment defers it.
